tours.name: Create a Department and Assign a Manager

name_i18n.en_US: Create a Department and Assign a Manager

tours.description: Learn how to add a department to the company structure: name it, choose its manager and parent department, and save it.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to add a department to the company structure: name it, choose its manager and parent department, and save it.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: Departments are managed from the Employees app, because they describe how the company's employees are organised.

description_i18n.en_US: Departments are managed from the Employees app, because they describe how the company's employees are organised.

steps.title: Departments
steps.description: This screen shows one card per department, with its manager and a summary of its activity. It is the starting point for every department change.

description_i18n.en_US: This screen shows one card per department, with its manager and a summary of its activity. It is the starting point for every department change.

steps.title: New department
steps.content: Click New to create a department.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to create a department.

steps.description: The New button opens a blank department form. Nothing is stored until you save it.

description_i18n.en_US: The New button opens a blank department form. Nothing is stored until you save it.

steps.title: Department name
steps.content: Type the department's name, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the department's name, then press Tab.

steps.description: The name appears on employee records, in the organisation chart and in reports. Choose a name your team will recognise, for example Sales or Finance.

description_i18n.en_US: The name appears on employee records, in the organisation chart and in reports. Choose a name your team will recognise, for example Sales or Finance.

steps.title: Search Manager
steps.content: Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

steps.description: The manager is the person who leads the department. Odoo uses this person as the default approver for time off and expenses of the department's employees. Typing narrows the list down; you pick the result in the next step.

description_i18n.en_US: The manager is the person who leads the department. Odoo uses this person as the default approver for time off and expenses of the department's employees. Typing narrows the list down; you pick the result in the next step.

steps.validation_message: Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

validation_message_i18n.en_US: Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

steps.title: Choose the manager
steps.content: Click the result you want in the list.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the result you want in the list.

steps.description: Pick the employee who leads this department. Start typing a name to narrow the list.

description_i18n.en_US: Pick the employee who leads this department. Start typing a name to narrow the list.

steps.title: Search Parent Department
steps.content: Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

steps.description: A parent department places this department under another one in the organisation chart. Leave it empty for a top-level department. Typing narrows the list down; you pick the result in the next step.

description_i18n.en_US: A parent department places this department under another one in the organisation chart. Leave it empty for a top-level department. Typing narrows the list down; you pick the result in the next step.

steps.validation_message: Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

validation_message_i18n.en_US: Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

steps.title: Choose the parent department
steps.content: Click the result you want in the list.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the result you want in the list.

steps.description: Pick the department this one belongs to. For example, a Recruitment team could sit under Human Resources.

description_i18n.en_US: Pick the department this one belongs to. For example, a Recruitment team could sit under Human Resources.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the department.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the department.

steps.description: Saving creates the department. It can then be chosen on employee records and used in reports.

description_i18n.en_US: Saving creates the department. It can then be chosen on employee records and used in reports.

steps.title: Department saved
steps.content: The department is saved. Click its name to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: The department is saved. Click its name to finish.

steps.description: The department name now appears at the top of the page. To add people to it, open each employee and choose this department.

description_i18n.en_US: The department name now appears at the top of the page. To add people to it, open each employee and choose this department.
